source.paper: Fang and Bartel 2015; Auyeung et al. 2013 motif priors

meta.leakage_guard: readout is measured selection_count/input_count normalized to WT within backbone; no processing predictor score is used as a label

anchoring.method: WT consensus was derived from input-count-weighted bases. Mature 5p/3p sequences were matched exactly in each fixed scaffold. Motif windows were then anchored to these scaffold landmarks: basal flank at 5p Drosha end, downstream basal flank after 3p Drosha end, and apical loop between mature arms. No de-novo RNA structure inference was used.
